'''Moorsey''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Moorsey originally worked as a mechanic on Cularin, in the [[platform city]] [[Lissken]]. However, his arm was crushed by faulty lifting equipment, so his employers gave him a prosthetic arm and paid him off, to avoid a lawsuit. Moorsey invested the money in the bar [[Spanner's]], in the city of [[Hedrett]] and started working there as a bartender. He was present when the [[heroes of Cularin]] visited Spanner's in about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].
